svg.text: own node at each size, drawn in (c)
(c) one layer per size: the tree over chains, and its run array with one entry (run, label) per node
Community(x, 3, 2): label 14 lies in chain 3, whose own node at size 3 is node 0 = N; N is a root with top 3 ≥ 2, so the climb stops there.
The entries of N and of the next node in preorder, A, are (0, 0) and (2, 3): first range [0, 3), whole run [8, 15), last range [3, 3) empty. Ten vertices in two ranges, shaded in (a).
